Pyu risarch sentar aur polaind ke instityut phor da stadi oph rilijan ki naee risarch riport 'da phyuchar oph varld rilijans' men 2070 tak duniya ki dharmik aabadi men hone vale sanbhavit badlavon ka anuman lagaya gaya hai. is riport ke mutabik, musalmanon ki aabadi barhne ki raftar sabse tez hogi, bharat hindu bahul desh bana rahega aur eesaee aabadi ka kendr dhire-dhire yurop se afrika ki or khisak sakta hai.
Janie is risarch ke aham aankre aur duniya ke dharmik bhavishy ki puri kahani.
